about: Academy step-script steps allowed to fail against the demo, each with its reason. tests-demo/academy-scripts.spec.ts plays every script in src/academy/scripts against the built demo and fails, naming the flow and step, on any action that errors or any highlight that finds nothing — unless the step is listed here. An entry that no longer fails is itself a failure, so the list only ever holds what is still true. Format: { "flow": "BLD-03", "step": 6, "reason": "..." }.
